title: Idiomalarni tabiiy ishlatish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida 20 dan ortiq keng tarqalgan inglizcha idiomani to‘g‘ri shaklda ishlatasiz, ularni vaziyat va uslubga qarab tanlaysiz, ortiqcha ishlatishdan saqlanasiz va og‘zaki imtihonda 2–3 ta idiomani tabiiy joylashtira olasiz.

vocab.uz: ham foyda, ham zarar keltiradigan narsa

vocab.w: get the wrong end of the stick
hit the nail on the head

vocab.uz: avval yomon tuyulib, keyin foydali chiqqan narsa

scenes.title: Idiomalar: bezak emas, vosita
board: Using idioms naturally
(Idiomalarni tabiiy ishlatish)
Right idiom · right moment · right amount
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda sinonimlar orasidagi nozik farqlarni ajratishni o‘rgandik. Bugun so‘z tanlashning eng nozik qatlami: idiomalar. Dars oxirida yigirmadan ortiq keng tarqalgan idiomani to‘g‘ri shaklda ishlatasiz, ularni vaziyatga qarab tanlaysiz va og‘zaki imtihonda tabiiy joylashtirasiz. Shiorimiz: to‘g‘ri idioma, to‘g‘ri paytda, to‘g‘ri miqdorda.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Today: idioms, not as decoration, but as a precise tool. The right idiom, at the right moment, in the right amount.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz. Bugun idiomalar: bezak emas, aniq vosita sifatida. To‘g‘ri idioma, to‘g‘ri paytda, to‘g‘ri miqdorda.

scenes.title: Idioma nima?
board: idiom = fixed phrase + non-literal meaning
spill the beans (sirni oshkor qilmoq)
under the weather (biroz betob)

examples.t: Who spilled the beans about the party?
examples.uz: Ziyofat haqidagi sirni kim oshkor qildi?

scenes.say_native: Idioma shunday birikmaki, uning ma’nosi alohida so‘zlardan kelib chiqmaydi. Spill the beans so‘zma-so‘z loviyani to‘kmoq, aslida sirni oshkor qilmoq. Under the weather esa biroz betob degani. B2 da siz idiomalarni tushunar edingiz, C1 da ularni o‘zingiz ishlatasiz. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar idiomani fikrni qisqaroq yoki obrazliroq aytish uchun ishlatadi. Biz ham faqat shu maqsadda ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: An idiom is a fixed phrase whose meaning you can't work out from the words. To spill the beans is to reveal a secret.
scenes.say_uz: Idioma ma’nosini so‘zlardan topib bo‘lmaydigan qat’iy birikma. Spill the beans sirni oshkor qilish degani.

scenes.title: Ish va mehnat idiomalari
board: get the hang of sth (o‘zlashtirib olmoq)
a steep learning curve (ko‘p narsani tez o‘rganish)
cut corners (chala-chulpa qilmoq)
pull your weight (o‘z ulushini bajarmoq)
scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: ish va o‘qish. Get the hang of something, ishni asta-sekin o‘zlashtirib olmoq. A steep learning curve, qisqa vaqtda ko‘p narsa o‘rganish kerak bo‘lgan holat, masalan, yangi ishda. Cut corners, vaqt yoki pul tejash uchun ishni sifatsiz qilmoq, bu doim tanqid. Pull your weight, jamoada o‘z ulushini bajarmoq, ko‘pincha inkorda ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: You get the hang of something when you finally learn how to do it. If you cut corners, you lose quality. In a team, everyone must pull their weight.
scenes.say_uz: Biror ishni nihoyat o‘rgansangiz, get the hang of it bo‘ladi. Cut corners qilsangiz, sifat yo‘qoladi. Jamoada har kim pull their weight qilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Ish idiomalari gapda
board: It took me a month to get the hang of it.
The builders cut corners.
Two people aren’t pulling their weight.

examples.t: It took me a month to get the hang of the new software.
examples.uz: Yangi dasturni o‘zlashtirishim uchun bir oy kerak bo‘ldi.

examples.t: The builders cut corners, and now the roof leaks.
examples.uz: Quruvchilar ishni chala qilishdi, endi tom chakka o‘tkazyapti.

examples.t: Two people in our group aren’t pulling their weight.
examples.uz: Guruhimizdagi ikki kishi o‘z ulushini bajarmayapti.

scenes.say_native: Shaklga e’tibor bering. Get the hang of dan keyin ot yoki it keladi: get the hang of the software, get the hang of it. Cut corners da corners doim ko‘plikda va artiklsiz. Pull your weight da olmosh egaga moslashadi: I pull my weight, they pull their weight. Bu idiomalar neytral uslubda, ish yig‘ilishida ham, do‘stlar orasida ham bemalol ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: It took me a month to get the hang of the new software. The builders cut corners, and now the roof leaks. Two people in our group aren't pulling their weight.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi dasturni o‘zlashtirishim uchun bir oy kerak bo‘ldi. Quruvchilar ishni chala qilishdi, endi tom chakka o‘tkazyapti. Guruhimizdagi ikki kishi o‘z ulushini bajarmayapti.

scenes.title: Muammo va qaror idiomalari
board: sit on the fence (tomon tanlamaslik)
a grey area (aniq bo‘lmagan holat)
the tip of the iceberg (aysbergning uchi)
a double-edged sword (ikki tomoni o‘tkir qilich)
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: muammo va qarorlar. Sit on the fence, ikki fikr orasida tomon tanlamay turmoq. A grey area, qoida aniq bo‘lmagan holat; amerikacha yozuvda gray. The tip of the iceberg, ko‘rinib turgan muammo kattaroq muammoning kichik qismi. A double-edged sword, ham foyda, ham zarar keltiradigan narsa. Oxirgi ikkitasi o‘zbek tilida ham bor: aysbergning uchi, ikki tomoni o‘tkir qilich. Bu eslab qolishni osonlashtiradi.
scenes.say: If you sit on the fence, you refuse to take sides. These complaints are only the tip of the iceberg. Social media is a double-edged sword.
scenes.say_uz: Sit on the fence qilsangiz, tomon tanlamaysiz. Bu shikoyatlar aysbergning faqat uchi. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ikki tomoni o‘tkir qilich.

scenes.title: Muloqot idiomalari
board: get the wrong end of the stick (noto‘g‘ri tushunmoq)
beat around the bush (gapni aylantirmoq)
hit the nail on the head (aynan to‘g‘ri aytmoq)
be on the same page (bir xil fikrda bo‘lmoq)
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi guruh: muloqot. Get the wrong end of the stick, birovni noto‘g‘ri tushunib olmoq, asosan britancha. Beat around the bush, asosiy gapga o‘tmay aylantirmoq; britaniyaliklar beat about the bush ham deydi. Hit the nail on the head, muammoning aynan mohiyatini aytmoq. Be on the same page, bir xil tushunchada bo‘lmoq. Bular yig‘ilish va muzokarada eng foydali to‘rtlik.
scenes.say: If you get the wrong end of the stick, you misunderstand. If you beat around the bush, you avoid the main point. If you hit the nail on the head, you're exactly right.
scenes.say_uz: Get the wrong end of the stick noto‘g‘ri tushunish. Beat around the bush asosiy gapdan qochish. Hit the nail on the head aynan to‘g‘ri aytish.

scenes.title: Yig‘ilishdan parchalar
board: I think you’ve got the wrong end of the stick.
Let’s not beat around the bush.
You’ve hit the nail on the head.

examples.t: I think you’ve got the wrong end of the stick. I didn’t cancel it.
examples.uz: Menimcha, noto‘g‘ri tushunibsiz. Men uni bekor qilmadim.

examples.t: Let’s not beat around the bush: the budget has been cut.

scenes.say_native: Yig‘ilishdagi tabiiy jumlalar. I think you’ve got the wrong end of the stick, muloyim tuzatish. Let’s not beat around the bush, yomon xabardan oldingi qulay kirish. You’ve hit the nail on the head, suhbatdoshni kuchli qo‘llab-quvvatlash. E’tibor bering, ular ko‘pincha present perfect bilan keladi: you’ve got, you’ve hit, chunki natija hozir muhim.
scenes.say: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick. Let's not beat around the bush: the budget has been cut. You've hit the nail on the head.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, noto‘g‘ri tushunibsiz. Gapni aylantirmaylik: byudjet qisqartirildi. Aynan to‘g‘ri aytdingiz.

scenes.title: Idioma shakli qat’iy
board: ✓ tense changes: hit → has hit
✓ pronoun changes: my / their weight
✗ words, articles, plurals do NOT change
scenes.say_native: Muhim qoida: idioma ichidagi so‘zlar qotib qolgan. Fe’l zamonga qarab o‘zgaradi, olmosh ham moslashadi. Lekin so‘zni sinonim bilan almashtirish, artiklni yoki birlik va ko‘plikni o‘zgartirish mumkin emas. The tip of the iceberg o‘rniga a top of an iceberg desangiz, idioma yo‘qoladi. Bu oldingi darsdagi hamrohlik qoidasining eng qattiq ko‘rinishi.
scenes.say: Idioms are frozen. You can change the tense and the pronoun, but not the words. It's the tip of the iceberg, never a top of an iceberg.
scenes.say_uz: Idiomalar qotib qolgan. Zamon va olmoshni o‘zgartirish mumkin, so‘zlarni emas. The tip of the iceberg, hech qachon a top of an iceberg emas.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: same image: the tip of the iceberg = aysbergning uchi
different image: over the moon = og‘zi qulog‘ida
✗ word-for-word translation of Uzbek idioms
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek idiomalari bilan uch xil munosabat bor. Birinchi, obraz bir xil: aysbergning uchi. Ikkinchi, ma’no bir xil, obraz boshqa: ingliz juda xursand bo‘lsa over the moon, biz og‘zi qulog‘ida deymiz. Uchinchi, umuman ekvivalenti yo‘q, masalan, pull your weight. Eng xavflisi: o‘zbekcha idiomani so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish. His mouth reached his ears desangiz, ingliz ma’noni tushunmaydi.
scenes.say: Some idioms share an image across languages, like the tip of the iceberg. Others don't: a delighted English speaker is over the moon.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi idiomalar ikki tilda bir xil obrazga ega, masalan, aysbergning uchi. Boshqalari yo‘q: juda xursand ingliz over the moon bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Buzilgan idiomalar
board: ✗ the wrong side of the stick → ✓ the wrong end
✗ hit the nail in the head → ✓ on the head
✗ cut the corners → ✓ cut corners
✗ we are on one page → ✓ on the same page
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. Wrong side of the stick emas, wrong end. Hit the nail in the head emas, on the head: o‘zbekcha boshiga desak, in bilan aytib yuboramiz. Cut the corners emas, artiklsiz cut corners. On one page emas, on the same page; bu bir sahifada degan o‘zbekcha mantiqdan keladi. Ko‘rib turibsizki, xatolar asosan predlog va artiklda. Idiomani yodlaganda aynan shularga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: The wrong end of the stick. Hit the nail on the head. Cut corners, with no article. On the same page. The small words are where idioms break.
scenes.say_uz: The wrong end of the stick. Hit the nail on the head. Cut corners, artiklsiz. On the same page. Idiomalar aynan kichik so‘zlarda buziladi.

scenes.title: Idiomani to‘ldiring
board: 1) It took weeks to get the ___ of it.
2) Don’t cut ___ with safety.
3) Social media is a double-___ sword.
4) That’s only the ___ of the iceberg.
5) Are we on the ___ page?
scenes.say_native: Endi siz. Beshta gapda idiomaning bitta so‘zi tushib qolgan. Birinchi: get the nima of it. Ikkinchi: don’t cut nima with safety. Uchinchi: a double nima sword. To‘rtinchi: only the nima of the iceberg. Beshinchi: are we on the nima page? Har bir gapni to‘liq, baland ovozda ayting, shunda idioma og‘zingizda bitta bo‘lak bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Complete each idiom. Get the blank of it. Don't cut blank with safety. A double-blank sword. Only the blank of the iceberg. Are we on the blank page?
scenes.say_uz: Har bir idiomani to‘ldiring. Get the ... of it. Don’t cut ... with safety. A double-... sword. Only the ... of the iceberg. Are we on the ... page?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) hang   2) corners   3) edged
4) tip   5) same
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: hang, corners, edged, tip, same. To‘liq gaplarni yana bir bor o‘zingiz ayting: get the hang of it, cut corners, a double-edged sword, the tip of the iceberg, on the same page. Agar edged ni edge deb aytgan bo‘lsangiz, e’tibor bering: bu sifatdosh, oxirida d bor. Beshtasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib natija.
scenes.say: Hang. Corners. Edged. Tip. Same.
scenes.say_uz: Hang. Corners. Edged. Tip. Same.

scenes.title: Kontekst va uslub
board: informal: spill the beans, a piece of cake
neutral: get the hang of, on the same page
formal-friendly: the tip of the iceberg
Check the label: informal / old-fashioned
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi asosiy nuqta: kontekst va uslub. Idiomalarning ko‘pi so‘zlashuv uslubida. Spill the beans, a piece of cake do‘stlar orasida yaxshi, hisobotda esa yoqimsiz. Get the hang of, on the same page neytral, ishda ham joyida. The tip of the iceberg va a double-edged sword esa gazeta maqolasida ham uchraydi. Lug‘atdagi informal yoki old-fashioned belgisini doim tekshiring.
scenes.say: Idioms have registers, just like words. A piece of cake is fine with friends but odd in a report. The tip of the iceberg can appear in a newspaper.
scenes.say_uz: Idiomalarning ham, so‘zlar kabi, uslubi bor. A piece of cake do‘stlar bilan yaxshi, hisobotda g‘alati. The tip of the iceberg gazetada ham uchraydi.

scenes.title: Bir fikr, uch uslub
board: Friend: The exam was a piece of cake!
Colleague: I’ve finally got the hang of the system.
Report: The cases may be only the tip of the iceberg.

examples.t: The reported cases may represent only the tip of the iceberg.
examples.uz: Qayd etilgan holatlar aysbergning faqat uchi bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Uch xil vaziyat. Do‘stingizga: the exam was a piece of cake. Hamkasbingizga: I’ve finally got the hang of the system. Rasmiy hisobotda: the reported cases may represent only the tip of the iceberg. Rasmiy matnda idioma ehtiyotkor so‘zlar bilan o‘ralgan: may, only. Akademik yozuvda idiomalar juda kam, ishlatilsa ham eng neytrallari, bitta-ikkitasi xolos.
scenes.say: To a friend: the exam was a piece of cake! In a report: the reported cases may represent only the tip of the iceberg.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stga: imtihon juda oson bo‘ldi! Hisobotda: qayd etilgan holatlar aysbergning faqat uchi bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Kimga gapiryapsiz?
board: pass away (polite) · die · kick the bucket (jokey)
pull sb’s leg (hazillashmoq, friends)
touch base, think outside the box (office jargon)
scenes.say_native: Uslub bilan birga tinglovchi ham muhim. Kick the bucket ham o‘lmoq degani, lekin hazil ohangida, shuning uchun motamda faqat pass away yoki die. Pull someone’s leg, hazillashmoq, yaqinlar orasida yaxshi. Touch base, think outside the box esa ofis jargoni: ko‘pchilikka siyqasi chiqqan iboradek eshitiladi. Shuning uchun avval kim tinglayotganini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Kick the bucket means to die, but it's jokey, so never use it about a real death. Touch base and think outside the box are tired office jargon.
scenes.say_uz: Kick the bucket o‘lmoq degani, lekin hazilomuz, shuning uchun haqiqiy o‘lim haqida ishlatmang. Touch base va think outside the box siyqasi chiqqan ofis jargoni.

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika variantlari
board: BrE a storm in a teacup · AmE a tempest in a teapot
BrE touch wood · AmE knock on wood
BrE beat about the bush · both: beat around the bush
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi idiomalar Britaniya va Amerikada farq qiladi. Arzimas narsa uchun shov-shuvni britaniyaliklar a storm in a teacup, amerikaliklar a tempest in a teapot deydi. Ko‘z tegmasin ma’nosida Britaniyada touch wood, Amerikada knock on wood. Bitta variantni tanlab, izchil ishlating: aralashtirish xato emas, lekin izchillik tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: In Britain, a fuss about nothing is a storm in a teacup; in America, a tempest in a teapot. The British touch wood; Americans knock on wood.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniyada arzimas shov-shuv a storm in a teacup, Amerikada a tempest in a teapot. Britaniyaliklar touch wood, amerikaliklar knock on wood deydi.

scenes.title: Uslub xatolari
board: ✗ (essay) The government should stop beating around the bush.
✓ The government should address the issue directly.
✗ (condolence) I heard he kicked the bucket.
✓ I was sorry to hear that he passed away.
scenes.say_native: Ikki jiddiy uslub xatosi. Birinchisi, akademik esseda: the government should stop beating around the bush. Bu so‘zlashuvga o‘xshab qoladi; yaxshisi, should address the issue directly. Ikkinchisi juda og‘ir: hamdardlik bildirganda kicked the bucket deyish haqorat bo‘lib eshitiladi. To‘g‘risi: I was sorry to hear that he passed away. Idiomaning qayerda ishlamasligini bilish ham kerak.
scenes.say: In an essay, say the government should address the issue directly. And in a condolence message, never say kicked the bucket; say passed away.
scenes.say_uz: Esseda hukumat masalani to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri hal qilishi kerak deng. Hamdardlik xabarida esa hech qachon kicked the bucket demang; passed away deng.

scenes.title: Mos keladimi?
board: 1) Email to a professor: “The task was a piece of cake.”
2) Team meeting: “Are we all on the same page?”
3) Report: “These cases may be the tip of the iceberg.”
4) Friend: “Are you pulling my leg?”
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat. Har birida idioma joyidami yoki yo‘q, ayting. Birinchi: professorga xatda, the task was a piece of cake. Ikkinchi: jamoa yig‘ilishida, are we all on the same page? Uchinchi: hisobotda, these cases may be the tip of the iceberg. To‘rtinchi: do‘st bilan suhbatda, are you pulling my leg? Mos kelmasa, qanday almashtirish mumkinligini ham o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Appropriate or not? An email to a professor: the task was a piece of cake. A meeting: are we all on the same page? A report: these cases may be the tip of the iceberg. A friend: are you pulling my leg?
scenes.say_uz: Mos keladimi? Professorga xat: the task was a piece of cake. Yig‘ilish: are we all on the same page? Hisobot: these cases may be the tip of the iceberg. Do‘st: are you pulling my leg?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) ✗ → I found the task manageable.
2) ✓ neutral, natural at work
3) ✓ hedged, formal-friendly
4) ✓ friendly, informal
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi mos emas: professorga a piece of cake juda erkin va biroz mag‘rur eshitiladi; yaxshisi, I found the task manageable. Ikkinchisi ish joyida tabiiy. Uchinchisi mos, chunki idioma neytral va may bilan yumshatilgan. To‘rtinchisi do‘stlar orasida juda tabiiy. Agar to‘rttasini to‘g‘ri baholagan bo‘lsangiz, uslub sezgingiz yaxshi rivojlangan.
scenes.say: One is inappropriate: write I found the task manageable. Two, three and four are fine in their contexts.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi mos emas: I found the task manageable deb yozing. Ikkinchi, uchinchi va to‘rtinchisi o‘z kontekstida joyida.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ofisdagi suhbat
board: Listen: Lena and Sam, a new project
Q1 How does Sam feel about the software?
Q2 What does Lena say about the deadlines?
Q3 What will Sam do?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Ikki hamkasb, Lena va Sam, yangi loyiha haqida gaplashadi. Uch savolga javob qidiring. Birinchi: Sam yangi dastur haqida qanday fikrda? Ikkinchi: Lena muddatlar haqida nima deydi? Uchinchi: Sam nima qilishga qaror qiladi? Suhbatda bugungi idiomalar tabiiy holda uchraydi, ularni ham sanab boring.
scenes.say: Lena: How are you finding the new software? Sam: It's a steep learning curve, but I'm getting the hang of it. Lena: Good. I won't beat around the bush. We've missed two deadlines, and I think that's just the tip of the iceberg. Sam: You've hit the nail on the head. Half the team isn't pulling their weight. Lena: Then let's get everyone on the same page on Monday. Sam: Fine. I'll set up the meeting.
scenes.say_uz: Lena: Yangi dastur qanday? Sam: Ko‘p narsani tez o‘rganish kerak, lekin o‘zlashtiryapman. Lena: Yaxshi. Gapni aylantirmayman. Ikki muddatni o‘tkazib yubordik va menimcha, bu aysbergning uchi xolos. Sam: Aynan to‘g‘ri. Jamoaning yarmi o‘z ulushini bajarmayapti. Lena: Unda dushanba kuni hammani bir fikrga keltiraylik. Sam: Mayli. Yig‘ilishni men tashkil qilaman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1 How does Sam feel about the software?
Q2 What does Lena say about the deadlines?
Q3 What will Sam do?
Bonus: How many idioms did you hear?
scenes.say_native: Endi javob bering, inglizcha va to‘liq gap bilan. Birinchi: Sam dastur haqida qanday fikrda? Ikkinchi: Lena muddatlar haqida nima deydi? Uchinchi: Sam nima qiladi? Qo‘shimcha savol: nechta idioma eshitdingiz? Javobingizda idiomani takrorlashingiz ham mumkin, masalan: Sam says it’s a steep learning curve. Shu yo‘l bilan idioma sizning nutqingizga o‘tadi.
scenes.say: How does Sam feel about the software? What does Lena say about the deadlines? What will Sam do? How many idioms did you hear?
scenes.say_uz: Sam dastur haqida qanday fikrda? Lena muddatlar haqida nima deydi? Sam nima qiladi? Nechta idioma eshitdingiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Hard at first, but he’s getting the hang of it.
2) The missed deadlines are just the tip of the iceberg.
3) He’ll set up a meeting for Monday.
Bonus: 7 idioms
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: dastur qiyin, lekin Sam uni asta-sekin o‘zlashtiryapti. Ikkinchi: Lena o‘tkazib yuborilgan muddatlar aysbergning uchi, ya’ni muammo kattaroq, deydi. Uchinchi: Sam dushanbaga yig‘ilish tashkil qiladi. Idiomalar yettita: steep learning curve, get the hang of, beat around the bush, tip of the iceberg, hit the nail on the head, pull their weight, on the same page. Qisqa suhbat uchun bu ancha ko‘p.
scenes.say: Sam is getting the hang of the software. Lena thinks the deadlines are just the tip of the iceberg. Sam will set up a meeting. Seven idioms: a lot!
scenes.say_uz: Sam dasturni o‘zlashtiryapti. Lena muddatlarni aysbergning uchi deb hisoblaydi. Sam yig‘ilish tashkil qiladi. Yettita idioma: bu ko‘p!

scenes.title: Ortiqcha ishlatishdan saqlaning
board: Rule of thumb: max 1 idiom per idea
An idiom must add meaning or brevity
Too many = a phrasebook, not a person
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi asosiy nuqta: ortiqcha ishlatmaslik. Idiomalar tuz kabi: oz bo‘lsa ta’m beradi, ko‘p bo‘lsa ovqatni buzadi. Amaliy qoida: bitta fikrga ko‘pi bilan bitta idioma. O‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu idioma oddiy so‘zdan aniqroq yoki qisqaroqmi? Yo‘q bo‘lsa, oddiy so‘zni ishlating. Ketma-ket uch-to‘rtta idioma aytgan odam tirik inson emas, so‘zlashuv kitobchasi kabi eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Idioms are like salt: a little adds flavour, too much ruins the dish. One idiom per idea at most.
scenes.say_uz: Idiomalar tuz kabi: ozgina ta’m beradi, ko‘pi taomni buzadi. Bitta fikrga ko‘pi bilan bitta idioma.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha va me’yorida
board: ✗ It was a piece of cake, I was over the moon and on cloud nine.
✓ The first week was easier than I expected, and I was over the moon when I got the job.

examples.t: The first week was easier than I expected, and I was over the moon when they offered me the job.
examples.uz: Birinchi hafta kutganimdan osonroq o‘tdi, ishni taklif qilishganda esa juda xursand bo‘ldim.

scenes.say_native: Ikki variantni solishtiring. Birinchisida bitta gapda uchta idioma: a piece of cake, over the moon, on cloud nine. Har biri to‘g‘ri, lekin birgalikda kulgili, xuddi yodlangan ro‘yxat. Ikkinchisida oddiy so‘zlar fikrni olib boradi, eng hissiy nuqtada esa bitta idioma bor: over the moon. Idioma ana shunda kuchli eshitiladi, chunki u ajralib turadi.
scenes.say: Too much: it was a piece of cake, I was over the moon and on cloud nine. Just right: the week was easier than I expected, and I was over the moon when I got the job.
scenes.say_uz: Haddan ortiq: juda oson edi, men juda xursand va yettinchi osmonda edim. Me’yorida: hafta kutganimdan osonroq bo‘ldi, ishga olinganimda esa juda xursand bo‘ldim.

scenes.title: Kichik iboralar katta ta’sir qiladi
board: fair enough (mayli, haqsiz)
that’s the thing (gap shundaki)
it’s not the end of the world (dunyo tugab qolmaydi)
I’ll keep you posted (xabardor qilib turaman)
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik bilmaydigan sir: tabiiylikni rangli idiomalar emas, kichik so‘zlashuv iboralari beradi. Fair enough, mayli, haqsiz. That’s the thing, gap shundaki. It’s not the end of the world, dunyo tugab qolmaydi. I’ll keep you posted, xabardor qilib turaman. Bular har kuni ishlatiladi va hech kimga g‘alati tuyulmaydi. Nutqingiz shular bilan to‘lsa, rangli idioma ham o‘z joyini topadi.
scenes.say: Natural speech is built on small chunks. Fair enough. That's the thing. It's not the end of the world. I'll keep you posted.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutq kichik bo‘laklarga quriladi. Fair enough. That’s the thing. It’s not the end of the world. I’ll keep you posted.

scenes.title: Ma’noni chalkashtirish
board: ✗ I’m under the weather because I failed. → ✓ I’m feeling down.
under the weather = slightly ill
once in a blue moon = very rarely
scenes.say_native: Ma’noni chalkashtirish ham ko‘p uchraydi. Under the weather xafa degani emas, biroz kasal degani. Imtihondan yiqilib xafa bo‘lsangiz, I’m feeling down deng. Once in a blue moon juda kamdan-kam degani. Ota-onangizni har hafta ko‘rib, bu idiomani ishlatsangiz, tinglovchi ularni deyarli ko‘rmaysiz deb o‘ylaydi. Yangi idiomani ishlatishdan oldin kamida uchta misolni ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Under the weather means slightly ill, not sad. Once in a blue moon means very rarely. Check real examples before you use an idiom.
scenes.say_uz: Under the weather biroz kasal degani, xafa emas. Once in a blue moon juda kamdan-kam degani. Idiomani ishlatishdan oldin haqiqiy misollarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Tabiiyroq qiling
board: Rewrite with ONE idiom only:
“University was a piece of cake, but I bit off more than I could chew, burned the candle at both ends and ended up under the weather.”
scenes.say_native: Endi tahrir qiling. Gapda to‘rtta idioma bor: a piece of cake; bite off more than you can chew, ya’ni kuchingiz yetmaydigan ishga qo‘l urmoq; burn the candle at both ends, o‘zini haddan ortiq charchatmoq; va under the weather. Gapni qayta tuzing: faqat bitta idioma qoldiring, qolganini oddiy so‘zlar bilan ayting. Eng ko‘p ma’no beradigan idiomani tanlang.
scenes.say: Rewrite with one idiom. University was a piece of cake, but I bit off more than I could chew, burned the candle at both ends and ended up under the weather.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta idioma bilan qayta yozing. Universitet juda oson edi, lekin kuchim yetmaydigan ishga qo‘l urdim, o‘zimni haddan ortiq charchatdim va kasal bo‘lib qoldim.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: University was easier than I expected, but I bit off more than I could chew: I took too many courses, slept very little and got ill.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. Biz bite off more than I could chew ni qoldirdik, chunki u hikoyaning mohiyatini aytadi. Ikki nuqtadan keyin tafsilotlar oddiy so‘zlar bilan: too many courses, slept very little, got ill. Burn the candle at both ends ni qoldirgan bo‘lsangiz ham to‘g‘ri. Muhimi, bitta idioma va uning atrofida aniq, oddiy til.
scenes.say: University was easier than I expected, but I bit off more than I could chew: I took too many courses, slept very little and got ill.
scenes.say_uz: Universitet kutganimdan osonroq edi, lekin kuchim yetmaydigan ishga qo‘l urdim: juda ko‘p kursga yozildim, kam uxladim va kasal bo‘ldim.

scenes.title: Og‘zaki imtihonda idiomalar
board: IELTS Lexical Resource:
Band 7: some less common and idiomatic vocabulary
Band 9: idiomatic language naturally and accurately
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: og‘zaki imtihonlar. IELTS speaking mezonlarida lug‘at bo‘limida idiomatik so‘zlar alohida tilga olinadi. Yettinchi ballda biroz kam uchraydigan va idiomatik so‘zlar, to‘qqizinchi ballda esa idiomatik tilni tabiiy va aniq ishlatish talab qilinadi. Kalit so‘zlar: tabiiy va aniq. Ya’ni idiomalar soni emas, to‘g‘ri joyda va to‘g‘ri shaklda ishlatilishi baholanadi.
scenes.say: In speaking exams such as IELTS, the top descriptors mention using idiomatic language naturally and accurately. Examiners don't count idioms.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS kabi og‘zaki imtihonlarda yuqori ballar idiomatik tilni tabiiy va aniq ishlatishni tilga oladi. Imtihon oluvchilar idiomalarni sanamaydi.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
board: 1) 2–3 idioms per common topic
2) Link each to a real story
3) Idiom + concrete detail
4) Unsure of the form? Plain English.
scenes.say_native: Amaliy strategiya. Ish, o‘qish, texnologiya, sayohat, oila kabi mavzular uchun ikki-uchtadan idioma tayyorlang. Har birini o‘z hayotingizdagi voqea bilan yodlang, shunda u yodlangan jumla emas, haqiqiy hikoya bo‘ladi. Idiomani faqat mos kelganda ishlating va darhol tafsilot qo‘shing. Shaklini aniq bilmasangiz, oddiy inglizcha ayting: buzilgan idioma idiomasiz javobdan yomonroq.
scenes.say: Prepare two or three idioms per topic, link each to a real story, and follow it with a detail. Unsure of the form? Use plain English.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir mavzuga ikki-uchta idioma tayyorlang, har birini haqiqiy voqeaga bog‘lang va ortidan tafsilot bering. Shaklini bilmasangiz, oddiy inglizcha ayting.

scenes.title: Imtihondagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ a memorised line that doesn’t answer the question
✗ an idiom with no follow-up
✗ a broken form: “It was a cake piece.”
✓ one fitting idiom + a specific detail
scenes.say_native: Imtihondagi tipik xatolar. Birinchi: savolga aloqasi yo‘q, oldindan yodlangan jumla. Imtihon oluvchilar buni darhol sezadi. Ikkinchi: idiomani aytib, hech qanday tafsilot bermaslik, shunda u bo‘sh qoladi. Uchinchi: hayajondan shaklni buzish, masalan, a cake piece. To‘g‘ri yo‘l oddiy: bitta mos idioma va ortidan aniq misol.
scenes.say: Memorised lines that don't answer the question, idioms with no follow-up and broken forms all cost you marks.
scenes.say_uz: Savolga javob bermaydigan yodlangan jumlalar, izohsiz idiomalar va buzilgan shakllar ball olib ketadi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy imtihon javobi
board: Q: Is it difficult to learn a new skill as an adult?
…a steep learning curve… My fingers hurt for weeks.
…once I got the hang of the basic chords…
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi javob namunasi. Savol: kattalar uchun yangi ko‘nikma o‘rganish qiyinmi? Nomzod gitara haqida gapiradi va ikkita idioma ishlatadi: steep learning curve va got the hang of. Har ikkisidan keyin aniq tafsilot bor: barmoqlar og‘rigani, kuniga yigirma daqiqa mashq. Shuning uchun idiomalar yodlangan emas, shaxsiy tajribadan chiqqandek eshitiladi.
scenes.say: When I started the guitar at thirty, there was a steep learning curve. My fingers hurt for weeks. But once I got the hang of the basic chords, I loved it.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz yoshda gitara chalishni boshlaganimda, ko‘p narsani o‘rganishga to‘g‘ri keldi. Barmoqlarim haftalab og‘ridi. Lekin asosiy akkordlarni o‘zlashtirgach, juda yoqib qoldi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: idioma bir bo‘lak
board: a piece of cake /ə ˈpiːs əv ˈkeɪk/
the tip of the ICEberg
get the HANG of it → hang‿of‿it
hit the nail on the HEAD
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Idiomani har so‘zni alohida urib aytsangiz, tabiiy eshitilmaydi. U bitta nafasda, bitta bo‘lak bo‘lib aytiladi. Of, the, a kabi kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz: of emas, əv. Asosiy urg‘u odatda oxirgi muhim so‘zga tushadi: the tip of the ICEberg, hit the nail on the HEAD. So‘zlar bog‘lanadi: hang of it deyarli bitta so‘zdek eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Say an idiom as one chunk. Of becomes /əv/. The stress falls on the last important word: the tip of the iceberg, hit the nail on the head.
scenes.say_uz: Idiomani bitta bo‘lak qilib ayting. Of /əv/ ga aylanadi. Urg‘u oxirgi muhim so‘zga tushadi: the tip of the iceberg, hit the nail on the head.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: It was a piece of CAKE.
That’s just the tip of the ICEberg.
I’m getting the HANG of it.
You’ve hit the nail on the HEAD.
scenes.say_native: Men bilan birga ayting. To‘rtta gap. Har birini bitta nafasda, kichik so‘zlarni yengil, urg‘uli so‘zni aniq va balandroq ayting. It was a piece of cake. That’s just the tip of the iceberg. I’m getting the hang of it. You’ve hit the nail on the head. Har birini ikki marta takrorlang, ikkinchi marta tezroq, lekin urg‘uni yo‘qotmasdan.
scenes.say: Repeat after me. It was a piece of cake. That's just the tip of the iceberg. I'm getting the hang of it. You've hit the nail on the head.
scenes.say_uz: Mendan keyin takrorlang. Bu juda oson edi. Bu aysbergning faqat uchi. Men buni o‘zlashtiryapman. Aynan to‘g‘ri aytdingiz.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
board: ✓ one breath per idiom
✓ weak of /əv/, the /ðə/
✓ stress on CAKE, ICEberg, HANG, HEAD
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Har bir idiomani bitta nafasda aytdingizmi? Of so‘zi qisqa əv bo‘ldimi? Urg‘u cake, iceberg, hang va head ga tushdimi? Har bir so‘zga bir xil kuch bergan bo‘lsangiz, nutq robotga o‘xshaydi. Bu tabiiy, chunki o‘zbek tilida gapdagi kichik so‘zlar bunchalik kuchsizlanmaydi. Ingliz tilida esa kuchsiz shakllar ritmning asosi.
scenes.say: One breath each? A weak /əv/? Stress on cake, iceberg, hang and head? If not, try again.
scenes.say_uz: Har biri bitta nafasdami? Kuchsiz /əv/? Urg‘u cake, iceberg, hang va head gami? Bo‘lmasa, yana urinib ko‘ring.

scenes.title: Hikoya uchun idiomalar
board: a blessing in disguise (zarardan chiqqan foyda)
miss the boat (imkoniyatni boy bermoq)
the ball is in your court (navbat sizda)
call it a day (bugunga yetar)

examples.t: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
examples.uz: O‘sha ishdan ayrilishim oxir-oqibat foydali bo‘lib chiqdi.

scenes.say_native: Hikoya uchun yana to‘rtta idioma. A blessing in disguise, avval yomon tuyulgan, keyin foydali chiqqan voqea. Miss the boat, vaqtida harakat qilmay imkoniyatni boy bermoq. The ball is in your court, endi qaror sizga bog‘liq. Call it a day, bugungi ishni tugatmoq. Barchasi neytral uslubda, uyga vazifadagi hikoyangiz uchun ham juda qulay.
scenes.say: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise. Apply now, or you'll miss the boat. The ball is in their court. Let's call it a day.
scenes.say_uz: O‘sha ishdan ayrilishim foydali chiqdi. Hozir ariza bering, aks holda imkoniyatni boy berasiz. Navbat ularda. Bugunga yetar.

scenes.title: Tinglash: imtihondagi javob
board: Listen: a candidate describes an unexpected change
Q1 What happened to the first plan?
Q2 Why was it a blessing in disguise?
Q3 Which idiom is used incorrectly?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Nomzod imtihonda hayotidagi kutilmagan o‘zgarish haqida gapiradi. Uch savol. Birinchi: birinchi rejasi bilan nima bo‘ldi? Ikkinchi: nega u buni a blessing in disguise deydi? Uchinchi, eng qiziq: qaysi idioma noto‘g‘ri ishlatildi? Ha, javobda bitta xato bor, uni topishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: I'd like to talk about the year I didn't get into medical school. I was devastated, but it turned out to be a blessing in disguise. I took a gap year, volunteered at a school and realised I loved teaching. I didn't want to miss the boat, so I applied straight away. Now I'm training to be a teacher, and I visit my old school once in a blue moon, almost every week.
scenes.say_uz: Tibbiyot oliygohiga kira olmagan yilim haqida gapirmoqchiman. Juda ezilgan edim, lekin bu oxir-oqibat foydali bo‘lib chiqdi. Bir yil tanaffus olib, maktabda ko‘ngilli bo‘ldim va o‘qituvchilikni yaxshi ko‘rishimni angladim. Imkoniyatni boy bermaslik uchun darhol ariza topshirdim. Hozir o‘qituvchilikka o‘qiyapman va eski maktabimga once in a blue moon, deyarli har hafta boraman.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
board: Q1 What happened to the first plan?
Q2 Why was it a blessing in disguise?
Q3 Which idiom is wrong, and why?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: nomzodning birinchi rejasi bilan nima bo‘ldi? Ikkinchi: nega bu voqea a blessing in disguise bo‘lib chiqdi? Uchinchi: qaysi idioma noto‘g‘ri ishlatildi va nima uchun? Keyin bir lahza imtihon oluvchi o‘rnida o‘ylang: qaysi idioma ball qo‘shdi, qaysi biri ball olib ketdi?
scenes.say: What happened to the first plan? Why was it a blessing in disguise? Which idiom was wrong?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi reja bilan nima bo‘ldi? Nega bu foydali chiqdi? Qaysi idioma noto‘g‘ri edi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Didn’t get into medical school
2) Gap year → a love of teaching
3) ✗ once in a blue moon (= very rarely)
✓ I visit my old school almost every week.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u tibbiyot oliygohiga kira olmadi. Ikkinchi: tanaffus yilida maktabda ishlab, o‘qituvchilikni sevib qoldi, shuning uchun muvaffaqiyatsizlik foydali chiqdi. Uchinchi: once in a blue moon xato, chunki u juda kamdan-kam degani, nomzod esa deyarli har hafta deydi. To‘g‘risi oddiy: I visit my old school almost every week. Qolgan ikki idioma joyida va tafsilot bilan ishlatilgan.
scenes.say: No medical school, but the gap year led to teaching: a blessing in disguise. Once in a blue moon was wrong; the speaker meant almost every week.
scenes.say_uz: Tibbiyot oliygohiga kirmadi, lekin tanaffus yili o‘qituvchilikka olib keldi: foydali chiqdi. Once in a blue moon xato edi; so‘zlovchi deyarli har hafta demoqchi edi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: hikoya
board: Speak for 1 minute: a time when a plan went wrong
Use 2–3 idioms from today
Each idiom + a concrete detail
Check: form · register · amount
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy og‘zaki topshiriq. Bir daqiqa davomida rejangiz buzilgan voqea haqida gapiring. Bugungi idiomalardan ikki-uchtasini ishlating, masalan, cut corners, a steep learning curve, a blessing in disguise. Har bir idiomadan keyin aniq tafsilot qo‘shing. Tugatgach, uch narsani tekshiring: shakl to‘g‘rimi, uslub mosmi, idiomalar soni me’yoridami? Telefoningizga yozib olsangiz, baholash oson bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Speak for one minute about a plan that went wrong. Use two or three idioms, each with a concrete detail.
scenes.say_uz: Buzilgan reja haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Ikki-uchta idioma ishlating, har biriga aniq tafsilot qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy hikoya
board: …we tried to cut corners…
…a steep learning curve…
…in the end, it was a blessing in disguise.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy hikoyada uchta idioma bor: cut corners, steep learning curve va blessing in disguise. Har biridan keyin aniq tafsilot keladi: tasvirlarning yarmi yaroqsiz chiqqani, montajni bir kechada o‘rgangani, keyin shu ko‘nikma ish topishga yordam bergani. Idiomalar hikoyaning boshida, o‘rtasida va oxirida tarqalgan, bir joyga to‘planmagan. Sizning hikoyangiz ham shunday bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: We tried to cut corners by skipping the planning, and half our footage was unusable. Learning editing overnight was a steep learning curve. But it was a blessing in disguise: that skill got me my first job.
scenes.say_uz: Rejalashtirishni tashlab, ishni yengillashtirmoqchi bo‘ldik va tasvirlarning yarmi yaroqsiz chiqdi. Montajni bir kechada o‘rganish juda qiyin bo‘ldi. Lekin bu foydali chiqdi: o‘sha ko‘nikma menga birinchi ishimni topib berdi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: 1) Learn the exact form (small words!)
2) Match the register and the listener
3) One idiom per idea, plus a detail
4) In tests: natural + accurate > many
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: idiomani aniq shaklda, predlog va artikllari bilan yodlang: on the head, the wrong end, cut corners. Ikkinchi: uslub va tinglovchini o‘ylang. Uchinchi: bitta fikrga bitta idioma va ortidan aniq tafsilot. To‘rtinchi: imtihonda soni emas, tabiiyligi va aniqligi baholanadi. Va unutmang, tabiiylikning katta qismini fair enough kabi kichik iboralar beradi.
scenes.say: Learn the exact form. Match the register. One idiom per idea, with a detail. Natural and accurate beats many.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq shaklni yodlang. Uslubga moslang. Bitta fikrga bitta idioma va tafsilot. Tabiiy va aniq ko‘pdan ustun.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write a story (200–250 words) with 8 idioms
Each: exact form + fitting register + a detail
Underline the idioms
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ikki yuz-ikki yuz ellik so‘zli hikoya yozing va unda sakkizta idiomani to‘g‘ri ishlating, ularning tagiga chizing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir idioma aniq shaklda, hikoya uslubiga mos, ortidan aniq tafsilot bilan kelgan va bir gapda ikkitadan ortiq idioma yo‘q. Keyingi darsda modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Write a story using eight idioms correctly, and underline them. Next time: advanced meanings of modal verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Sakkizta idiomani to‘g‘ri ishlatib hikoya yozing va tagiga chizing. Keyingi safar: modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolari.

homework_uz: 200–250 so‘zli hikoya yozing va unda 8 ta idiomani to‘g‘ri ishlating, ularning tagiga chizing. Mezon: har bir idioma aniq shaklda (predlog va artikllari bilan), hikoya uslubiga mos, ortidan aniq tafsilot kelgan va bir gapda ikkitadan ortiq idioma yo‘q.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form of the idiom.
options: You've hit the nail in the head.
You've hit a nail on a head.
You've hit the nails on the head.
You've hit the nail on the head.
quiz.why_uz: Idioma qat’iy: hit the nail on the head. O‘zbekcha “boshiga” in emas, on bilan keladi.

quiz.q: "I think you've got the wrong ___ of the stick."
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ri shakl: get the wrong end of the stick, ya’ni noto‘g‘ri tushunmoq.

options: to do something cheaply or quickly, lowering quality
quiz.why_uz: Cut corners vaqt yoki pul tejash uchun ishni sifatsiz qilmoq, doim tanqid ohangida.

quiz.q: Which sentence is most appropriate in an academic essay?
options: The data were a piece of cake to analyse.
Researchers should stop beating around the bush.
The reported cases may represent only the tip of the iceberg.
The results were the bee's knees.
quiz.why_uz: The tip of the iceberg rasmiy matnda ham uchraydi; boshqalari so‘zlashuv yoki eskirgan iboralar.

quiz.q: Your colleague's grandfather has died. What do you say?
options: I heard he kicked the bucket.
I was so sorry to hear that he passed away.
I heard he's under the weather.
quiz.why_uz: Kick the bucket hazil ohangida; hamdardlikda faqat passed away yoki died ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: "I'm a bit under the weather today." The speaker is…
quiz.why_uz: Under the weather biroz betob degani; xafa bo‘lsangiz, feeling down deysiz.

quiz.q: Which version uses idioms most naturally?
options: The interview was easier than I expected, and I was over the moon when they called.
It was a piece of cake and I was over the moon and on cloud nine.
I hit the ground running, it was a piece of cake, a blessing in disguise.
I was on cloud nine over the moon.
quiz.why_uz: Bitta fikrga bitta idioma: oddiy til va hissiyot cho‘qqisida bitta idioma eng tabiiy.

quiz.q: What is the American equivalent of the British "touch wood"?
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada touch wood, Amerikada knock on wood deyiladi.

quiz.q: "I've sent them my offer, so now the ___ is in their court."
quiz.why_uz: The ball is in their court: endi navbat ularda, qaror ularga bog‘liq.

quiz.q: According to IELTS speaking descriptors, what matters most about idioms?
quiz.why_uz: Yuqori ball uchun idiomatik til tabiiy va aniq ishlatilishi kerak, soni emas.
